 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE NAVIN CHAWLA  ORDER % 16.01.2024 CRL.M.A. 1390/2024 (Exemption)
1. Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.

2. This application has been filed by the applicant under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 (in short, 'Cr.P.C.'), praying for grant of anticipatory bail in FIR No. 0973/2023 registered with Police Station: Mahendra Park, Delhi under Sections 376/506/323/120-B/420/109 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 (in short, 'IPC').
3. Issue notice.
4. Notice is accepted by Mr.Aman Usman, learned APP on behalf of the State.
5. Notice be also issued to the prosecutrix/victim, to be served through the concerned IO.
